_comment: Differences from production that exist only because a committed migration has not been deployed there yet. Every entry names the migration that closes it; tests/db/parity.mjs tolerates exactly these and fails on anything else. Delete an entry right after applying the migration, so the file always reflects reality.
_policies_note: Policy expressions cannot be fingerprinted across Postgres versions; tests/db/security.mjs asserts their behaviour instead.

functions.register_push_subscription(p_endpoint te: 20261110160000_harden_push_registration.sql stops an endpoint being moved to another account (P0 takeover fix)

grants.poll_vote_counts:authenticated:MAINTAIN,: 20261110150000_reconcile_with_production.sql revokes TRUNCATE/REFERENCES/TRIGGER/MAINTAIN from authenticated, keeping SELECT

tables.push_log: 20261110180000_push_log.sql adds push dedup/rate-limit storage for send-push
